correctness.rationale: For p>=5 with gcd(5,p-1)=1, fifth power permutes nonzero residues and a representation uses u outside {0,a,a/2}. For p≡1 mod5 with p>=241 the smooth genus-six Fermat curve X^5+Y^5=aZ^5 has >=p+1-12sqrt(p)>40 F_p points, while excluded infinity, coordinate-zero, and equal-fifth-power loci total <=40, forcing distinct nonzero pair values; a=0 uses u,-u. The remaining 11 primes 1 mod5 below 241 are completely enumerated with explicit missing residues. A fresh independent exact two-summand algorithm verified all primes <=240 and all six missing-count entries. No large-prime conclusion is inferred from enumeration.
residual_risks: Computational bounded checks are not proofs for infinite or continuum assertions; critical analytic steps were reconstructed.
